classification.difficultyReason: Identify three transversal relationships in four differently oriented labelled diagrams.

inlines.text: the angle corresponding to the marked angle
the angle alternate to the marked angle
the angle co-interior to the marked angle.

spec.description: AB and CD rise gently rightward; transversal P–Q–R–S rises more steeply. All eight labels and the acute sector between RP and RD are retained. No parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: Marked angle QRD; intersections Q and R.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and marked sector are visible.

answer.worked: $\angle PQB$ occupies the corresponding position at $Q$.
$\angle AQR$ is between $AB$ and $CD$, on the opposite side of transversal $PS$ from the marked angle.
$\angle BQR$ is between $AB$ and $CD$, on the same side of transversal $PS$ as the marked angle.

spec.description: P–L–Q and R–K–S slope down rightward; transversal M–L–K–J rises gently. The obtuse sector LKS is marked; no parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: Marked angle LKS; intersections L and K.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and marked sector are visible.

answer.worked: $\angle MLQ$ occupies the corresponding position at $L$.
$\angle PLK$ is between $PQ$ and $RS$, on the opposite side of transversal $MJ$ from the marked angle.
$\angle QLK$ is between $PQ$ and $RS$, on the same side of transversal $MJ$ as the marked angle.

spec.description: Steep lines X–M–Y and S–N–T slope down rightward, crossed by L–M–N–O. Obtuse angle NMY is marked; all labels retained, without parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: Marked angle NMY; intersections M and N.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and marked sector are visible.

answer.worked: $\angle TNO$ occupies the corresponding position at $N$.
$\angle SNM$ is between $XY$ and $ST$, on the opposite side of transversal $LO$ from the marked angle.
$\angle TNM$ is between $XY$ and $ST$, on the same side of transversal $LO$ as the marked angle.

spec.description: Upper line through F and B has an unlabelled right endpoint; lower line is V–C–W. Transversal is D–C–B–A. Acute angle FBC is marked. No parallel arrows or invented endpoint label are printed.
spec.mathematics: Marked angle FBC; intersections B and C.

answer.worked: $\angle VCD$ occupies the corresponding position at $C$.
$\angle WCB$ is between the two lines, on the opposite side of transversal $AD$ from the marked angle.
